hypothesis: All four development failures occurred before motion at moka_pot_2's approach: each registered-reference run supplied only one candidate, and that candidate was rejected during descent for collision with moka_pot_2 itself, with approximately 0.0021-0.0022 m penetration at grasp. The placement geometry, order, and heights were never exercised, so they are unchanged. I removed both single-candidate grasp_reference_id overrides, allowing the executor's normal collision-checked grasp planner to select feasible top-down grasps. Moka pot 2 remains first on the right and moka pot 1 second on the left. The stove turn-on predicate already holds and requires no unsupported action.
